root_cause.text: Lack of mutex protection when reading RNDIS configuration options (class/subclass/protocol) in rndis_bind(), allowing concurrent modification via configfs to cause race conditions and inconsistent values being used.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `scoped_guard(mutex, &rndis_opts->lock)` around the reads of `rndis_opts->class`, `subclass`, and `protocol` in `rndis_bind()`. The commit message explicitly states these options are "susceptible to race conditions as they can be accessed concurrently through configfs."
